paragraphs.text: Matt Knicl , is a former Creative Text Contractor (2008-2013) and Creative Writer (2013-2014) at Wizards of the Coast . He worked on short fiction for Uncharted Realms , world building, flavor text , card names , design projects, continuity management/research, and other text requirements for Magic: The Gathering . He also worked on Dungeons & Dragons .
Knicl was the Creative Text Lead for Dragons of Tarkir .
Since October 2014 he works as a QA Tester through Aerotek at Nintendo .
